title: The use of a versatile o-vanilloyl hydrazone ligand to prepare SMM-like Dy3 molecular cluster pairs

material_class.structural_family: Dy6 molecular cluster pair (two covalently linked Dy3 triangles)

synthesis.procedure: To a solution of H2apovh (0.20 mmol, 0.057 g) and triethylamine (0.07 mL, 0.5 mmol) in MeOH/CH3CN (1:3) was added solid Dy(SCN)3·6H2O (0.045 g, 0.1 mmol). The mixture was stirred for six hours. The yellow solution was left unperturbed for slow solvent evaporation in air; yellow single crystals formed after one week, were collected by filtration, washed with cold methanol, and dried in air.

reagents.name: triethylamine
reagents.amount: 0.07 mL, 0.5 mmol (2.5 equiv. relative to ligand in the main-text description)

synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction in air followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: yellow solution left unperturbed for slow evaporation; yellow crystals filtered, washed with cold methanol, and dried in air
synthesis.yield: 38 mg (19%, based on the metal salt)

properties.summary: Dy6 MCP shows SMM-like slow magnetic relaxation. Room-temperature χMT = 88.3 cm3 K mol−1 matches six free DyIII ions; a second drop below ~20 K is attributed to intramolecular antiferromagnetic coupling/anisotropy. Zero-field ac data give Ueff = 29 K and τ0 = 4.2 × 10−6 s above 6 K; τ saturates at lower T (ground-state tunneling). No M(H) hysteresis at 1.9 K. Cole–Cole α > 0.3 (1.9–7 K). A 700 Oe dc field has little effect on the dynamics. Magnetization at 1.9 K and 7 T is 33.7 μB, below the 60 μB free-ion saturation.

measurements.conditions: room temperature; polycrystalline sample; dc χMT also shown at 1000 Oe (Fig. S2)
